title: I Abandoned Neutral Strangles After This Research
description:
tastylive examines research comparing bullish strangles against neutral strangles in different market environments. This episode explores how adjusting position deltas may impact returns and volatility over time. The analysis includes twenty years of data on various strangle configurations and their performance characteristics. Educational content focuses on understanding risk management approaches and strategy selection considerations for different market conditions.
